notes.title: Important Content Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32092906/a5fc47e4598dd2031f0c728849138fecc33e9ee6.png[/img]
A few days ago I released an important patch that should improve the game.

[h1] List of the changes: [/h1] [list]
    [*]Improved Textures
    [*]Added Secondary Fire
    [*]Changes to melee attack
    [*]New Enemies and changes to already existing enemies
    [*]Improved dialogue system and subtitles
    [*]Now you can execute stunned enemies
   [/list] 
[h1] BugFixes: [/h1] [list]
    [*]Solved a bug that can prevent to open inventory and options menu
    [*]Solved a bug of the shop
    [*]Solved a bug of the first boss
 [*]Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.content:

-Other bugfixes.

notes.title: Release delayed to 18 may 2018
notes.content: We decided to delay the release of Entropy2120 to fix some bugs. The Game Will be released on 18 may 2018. We are really sorry for this delay. ːsteamsadː
